latest_census.notes: Censo Nacional de Población, Hogares y Viviendas 2022 (61 questions, first bimodal census). Ethnicity is two universal self-recognition questions: indigenous or descendant of indigenous peoples, naming the pueblo (58 pueblos; 1,306,730 people, 2.9% of the population in private dwellings), and Afro-descendant (302,936 people, 0.7%; universal for the first time -- in 2010 it was asked only on a sample). Religion has not been asked since 1960: only the 1947 and 1960 censuses carried it; a religion item was tested in the 2020 pilot and dropped from the final form (Aleteia, Chequeado, Religión en Argentina snippets). Language: asked only of people who self-identified as indigenous, as whether they speak and/or understand the language of their pueblo (29.3% said yes) -- an ability question on a subpopulation, not a mother-tongue or home-language composition; the Tejido organisation criticised exactly this narrowing (Agencia Presentes snippet).

tier_reason: Census 2022 counts indigenous and Afro-descendant self-recognition, and censo.gob.ar's per-province final-results pages say the tables are published in .xlsx by departamento, which is the boundary's admin2 (525). Confidence is medium because the xlsx links themselves were not surfaced and there are 24 pages to walk. Religion and language are not asked (Tier C for those two fields: religion last asked 1960; language asked only of the indigenous-identified as an ability).
recommended_action: Open one province page (datos_definitivos_cordoba) and confirm an .xlsx with 'Población que se reconoce indígena o descendiente de pueblos indígenas u originarios' by departamento; then walk all 24 jurisdiction pages (the URL slugs vary: rionegro, santiago_del_estero). Build a three-class ethnicity composition -- indigenous / Afro-descendant / neither -- as Mexico's ITER is built, labelled as self-recognition, not an ethnic-group question; check whether Afro-descendant is also tabulated by department or only by jurisdiction. Declare religion not_collected (not asked since 1960; 2020 pilot item dropped) and language not_collected (asked only of the indigenous-identified, as ability). Check whether the boundary's 23 admin1 shapes include CABA, because the census reports 24 jurisdictions. Watch admin2 name ambiguity ('San Martín', 'General San Martín', 'Capital' in eleven provinces): join within province.

summary: Argentina's 2022 census does not ask religion (last asked 1960) and asks language only of people who identified as indigenous, as an ability, so both fields should be declared not_collected with those reasons. What it does count, universally, is indigenous self-recognition (58 pueblos, 2.9%) and Afro-descendant self-recognition (0.7%), published by INDEC in national PDFs by jurisdiction (24, versus 23 boundary shapes) and, per censo.gob.ar's per-province final-results pages, in .xlsx by departamento, the boundary's admin2. The realistic build is a three-class self-recognition composition for admin2 from 24 provincial workbooks, then aggregated to admin1, with the xlsx links confirmed on one page first.
